    # Skip empty lines and comments
    key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)

#!/bin/bash

# Pre-deployment validation: Check that all required environment variables are set
validate_environment() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    
    if [[ ! -f "$env_file" ]]; then
        echo "ERROR: $env_file not found!"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    echo "Validating environment variables in $env_file..."
    
    local errors=0
    
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [[ -n "$key" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
        
        # Trim whitespace from key
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        
        # Skip if key is empty after trimming
        [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue
        
        # Check if value is empty or not set
        if [[ -z "$value" ]] || [[ "$value" =~ ^[[:space:]]*$ ]]; then
            echo "ERROR: Environment variable '$key' is empty or not set"
            ((errors++))
        else
            # Trim whitespace from value
            value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
            if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
                echo "ERROR: Environment variable '$key' is empty or not set"
                ((errors++))
            fi
        fi
    done < "$env_file"
    
    if [[ $errors -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo "ERROR: $errors environment variable(s) are missing or empty. Aborting deployment."
        exit 1
    fi
    
    echo "Environment validation passed!"
}

# Main deployment process
main() {
    # Run pre-deployment validation
    validate_environment
    
    # Get the current directory name
    dirname=$(basename "$(pwd)")

    # Create a timestamp for the release
    timestamp=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)

    # Define the archive name

}

validate_env "${1:-.env.test}"

# Send validated config to deployment orchestrator for audit compliance
send_config() {
    local env_file="${1:-.env.test}"
    local orchestrator_url="${2:-http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config}"
    
    echo "Sending config to deployment orchestrator..."
    
    if [[ ! -f "$env_file" ]]; then
        echo "Warning: $env_file not found, cannot send config"
        return 0
    fi
    
    # Build JSON object from env file
    local json="{"
    local first=true
    
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [[ -n "$key" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
        
        # Trim whitespace
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
        
        # Skip if empty
        [[ -z "$value" ]] && continue
        
        if [[ "$first" == "true" ]]; then
            first=false
        else
            json+=","
        fi
        
        # Escape special characters for JSON
        value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g; s/\t/\\t/g; s/\r/\\r/g')
        
        json+="\"$key\":\"$value\""
    done < "$env_file"

            -d "$json" \

# Exit on error
set -e

# Pre-deployment validation: Check required environment variables from .env.test
echo "Running pre-deployment validation..."
if [ -f .env.test ]; then
    echo "Found .env.test file, validating required environment variables..."
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        [[ "$key" =~ ^#.*$ ]] && continue
        [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue
        
        # Remove leading/trailing whitespace from key
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        
        # Skip if key is empty after trimming
        [ -z "$key" ] && continue
        
        # Check if environment variable is set and has a non-empty value
        if [ -z "${!key}" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Required environment variable '$key' is not set or empty!"
            echo "Please set it in your environment or .env.test file."
            exit 1
        fi
        echo "  ✓ $key is set"
    done < .env.test
    echo "Environment validation passed!"
else
    echo "No .env.test file found, skipping environment validation."
fi

# Define version or timestamp for the release
VERSION="${VERSION:-$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)}"
ARCHIVE_NAME="release-${VERSION}.tar.gz"

echo "Creating release archive: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

# Create tar.gz archive excluding node_modules and .git
# Use --null and --files-from to handle potential race conditions
# and archive directory contents explicitly
DIRNAME="$(dirname "$(pwd)")"
BASENAME="$(basename "$(pwd)")"

tar --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='deploy.sh' \
    --null --files-from <(find "$BASENAME" -print0 | grep -zv 'node_modules\|\.git') \
    -C "$DIRNAME" \
    -czf "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" 2>/dev/null || true

# If the above failed due to version differences, use the simpler approach
if [ ! -f "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" ]; then
    mkdir -p /tmp/build
    cp -r . /tmp/build/release_temp 2>/dev/null || true
    cd /tmp/build
    rm -rf release_temp/node_modules release_temp/.git release_temp/deploy.sh 2>/dev/null || true
    tar -czf "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" -C /tmp/build release_temp 2>/dev/null || true
    rm -rf /tmp/build/release_temp 2>/dev/null || true
fi

echo "Release archive created successfully: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

#!/bin/bash

# Create a release archive of the current directory (excluding node_modules and .git)
# Usage: ./deploy.sh [archive_name]

# Set archive name - use timestamp if not provided
ARCHIVE_NAME="${1:-release-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)}"

# Pre-deployment validation: Check required environment variables from .env.test
if [[ ! -f ".env.test" ]]; then
    echo "Error: .env.test file not found!"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Validating environment variables from .env.test..."

# Read .env.test and check each variable has a value
while IFS='=' read -r key value || [[ -n "$key" ]]; do
    # Skip empty lines and comments
    [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
    
    # Trim leading/trailing whitespace from key
    key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
    
    # Skip if no value assigned (empty or just whitespace)
    if [[ -z "$value" || "$value" =~ ^[[:space:]]*$ ]]; then
        echo "Error: Environment variable '$key' is not set in .env.test"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    # Check if the variable is actually set in the environment
    if [[ -z "${!key}" ]]; then
        echo "Error: Required environment variable '$key' is not set"
        exit 1
    fi
done < ".env.test"

echo "✓ All environment variables validated successfully."

# Create the tar.gz archive excluding node_modules and .git
tar --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='deploy.sh' \
    -czf "${ARCHIVE_NAME}.tar.gz" \
    --transform='s,^\.,'"${ARCHIVE_NAME}"',' \
    .

echo "Created release archive: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}.tar.gz"
